meta.method: Volume = Pinterest 'people searched this' count on pinterest.com/ideas pages (Pinterest-rounded), found via TinyFish search (include_domains=pinterest.com, location=US). Trend signals from trends.pinterest.com logged-out view. Competition checked only for the top ~3 keywords per niche (not 5, to limit search spend): top-10 Pinterest results per exact phrase; exact = non-ideas pins/boards whose title contains the phrase, fresh = results dated/titled 2026, filler = pinterest ideas/shopping pages. Rated Low/Medium/High by hand. Keywords without a visible count were skipped. Search snippets sometimes show other-region (ca/nz/za) pages; counts are as shown.
meta.comparison_note: First run: keywords-daily/ did not exist, so 'new_or_rising' compares against existing repo JSON files only (new = phrase not found in any of them). 'rising' needs a previous daily run or trend % and is only set where a repo file shows a lower volume.
meta.competition_checked_note: competition null = not checked this run
meta.seasonal_note: Heavy Christmas/holiday weighting because of date (Nov 24).
